How LLM citation share is measured

A 2024 study (arXiv:2311.09735) found that 30-40% relative lift in LLM impressions is achievable via three tactics: citing sources, adding quotations, and adding statistics.

"We find that GEO can boost visibility by up to 40% in generative engine responses." — Aggarwal et al., KDD 2024

According to the Semrush 2024 study, 47.9% of ChatGPT top-10 citations come from a single source: Wikipedia.

  • ChatGPT search: 71% of citations from authoritative sources (source)
  • Perplexity: 63% (source)
